test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Nov, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹2500 as a sum borrowed at 3% per year rate of interest for 3 years.
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹2500

Rate of interest (R) = 3% per year

Time (T) = 3 years

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) / 100

**Calculation:**

Substituting the values:

SI = (2500 × 3 × 3) / 100

⇒ SI = (2500 × 9) / 100

⇒ SI = 22500 / 100

⇒ SI = ₹225

**The simple interest is ₹225.**
